translated_title: Mexican Government Rules Out Cyclospora Contamination in Taylor Farms Lettuce in Mexico
original_title: Gobierno de México descarta contaminación de cyclospora en lechugas de Taylor Farms en México
author: Ángeles Cruz Martínez
meta_description: Mexican food-safety regulators found no parasite or fecal coliforms, confirming that the U.S. FDA's contamination alert on the lettuce was a false positive.
